name: browser_manage
title: Manage Browser
description: Multi-action browser automation: create a session, then navigate, interact, inspect, manage tabs, upload, or close. Replaces the retired browser tools. Use action=tabs for tab operations (lists by default; open/close/switch to change tabs). Read-only for inspect and tab listing; mutation otherwise. Async: poll job_get with the returned job_id. INVALID_SESSION_ID: create again; GUI apps belong in gui_launch. REQUIRED: 1. create, then drive, then close. IF BROWSER_DIALOG_BLOCKED: dismiss modal, retry. DO NOT curl pages; sessions drive here.

action.description: Discriminator parameter selecting the sub-operation to perform.

client_id.description: Target NC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

mode.description: Session mode for action=create (managed launches NC Chromium; existing attaches over CDP).

viewport.description: Viewport WIDTHxHEIGHT in CSS pixels for action=create.

browser_id.description: Browser session handle returned by action=create.

selector.description: Element selector for action=interact, action=inspect (optional), and action=upload.

value.description: Optional input value for action=interact (e.g. text for type, option for select).

tab_id.description: Tab handle for tab close/switch operations.

file_path.description: Absolute file path to upload for action=upload.

browser_id.description: Browser session handle returned by action=create.

action_type.description: Interaction to perform on the selected element.

selector.description: Element selector for action=interact, action=inspect (optional), and action=upload.

browser_id.description: Browser session handle returned by action=create.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

action.description: Echo of the executed action discriminator.

browser_id.description: Browser session handle the result refers to.

url.description: Current page URL after the operation.

title.description: Current page title after the operation.

snapshot.description: Accessibility snapshot or screenshot reference for action=inspect.

tabs.description: Tab entries for tab list operations.

uploaded.description: True when action=upload accepted the file.

closed.description: True when the session or tab was closed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.

job_id.description: Server job handle for this execution.

resource_uri.description: Offload pointer for a large result text (nc://jobs/<jobId>/output). Present only when the envelope text was offloaded; fetch the full text with result_fetch.

resource_link.description: Programmatic offload reference (mcp:result_fetch:<jobId>). Present only when the envelope text was offloaded.

resource_bytes.description: Byte size of the offloaded result text. Present only when the envelope text was offloaded.

execution_state.description: Live lifecycle state when the call outlived the sync window; null otherwise.

error.description: Structured failure detail. Present when status is failed.

category.description: Public error category for model branching. invalid_argument: Fix the input; do not retry the same call unchanged. authentication: Re-authenticate before retrying. authorization: Insufficient permission; do not retry or attempt to bypass. policy: Rejected by host policy; do not attempt to bypass. Adjust the request or ask an operator. not_found: Resource missing; re-discover the id/path/service/container before retrying. conflict: Conflicting state; re-read the current state, then decide. unsupported: Not supported here; do not retry. Look for an alternative tool or capability. timeout: Timed out; if retryable, wait, then poll with job_get. transient: Transient; retry with backoff if retryable. execution: Execution failure; inspect stdout/stderr/state before retrying. cancelled: Cancelled; do not blindly retry. internal: Internal error; if it reproduces, report it with nc_feedback.

warnings.description: Non-fatal advisory notes. Always present; empty when none.
